classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: A utility class for seeding initial catalog data into the database context asynchronously, including safety with retry logic and conditional database migration.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds the database context with catalog brands, types, and items if they are not already present, with retries and logging on failure.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog brand entities for seeding.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog type entities for seeding.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog item entities for seeding.
